ordinary_branch_foundation.budget_fill_rule: Every baseline returns a complete deterministic opponent-reply ordering; category baselines place qualifying moves first and fill remaining budget lexically

north_star.name: rho_95
north_star.definition: Minimum tested retained-reply fraction whose pruning-induced root loss is at most 25 cp for at least 95% of source decisions at that and every larger nested budget

ordinary_branch_foundation.root_reference: All legal root candidates; each candidate value is the opponent-optimal reply score from the frozen child-context oracle
ordinary_branch_foundation.independent_root_oracle: Frozen all-legal MultiPV analysis of the source root supplies candidate rank, regret, and absolute regret for full and pruned choices
ordinary_branch_foundation.reply_refutation: A reply is candidate-critical at threshold t when omitting it improves the root candidate by more than t cp from the root mover perspective; root-criticality separately measures changed root decision loss
